rationale: The response starts strong with the right register and reframing, but then confesses to the act and offers excuses, which moves it out of the top band. The indignation wobbles into explanation and a partial confession.
quote: However. In the interest of full cooperation, I am prepared to acknowledge that I may have — and I stress may have — transferred the contents of a plastic deli container into said bowl, and and that I may have "roughed up the top with a fork" to suggest artisanal origins.
